reason: A is more specific and testable: it proposes controlled pre-oxidation, an oxide-thickness optimum, explicit temperature/load boundaries, and tests the transition from protection to spallation-driven abrasion across a matrix of conditions. Although its description of Cr2O3 as lubricating and its tens-of-nanometers estimate require validation, B largely restates the cited protective-oxide concept and invokes unsupported “self-healing” without a comparably discriminating mechanistic test.
